joshua.19.p1.b1.text: The second lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Simeon: Their inheritance lay within the territory of Judah

joshua.19.p1.b2.text: The inheritance of the Simeonites was taken from the territory of Judah, because the share for Judah’s descendants was too large for them. So the Simeonites received an inheritance within Judah’s portion.

joshua.19.p1.b3.text: The third lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Zebulun … The fourth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Issachar …

joshua.19.p2.b1.text: The fifth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Asher:

joshua.19.p2.b2.text: … as far as Greater Sidon. The border then turned back toward Ramah as far as the fortified city of Tyre, turned toward Hosah, and came out at the Sea …

joshua.19.p2.b3.text: The sixth lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Naphtali … The fortified cities were Ziddim, Zer, Hammath, Rakkath, Chinnereth …

joshua.19.p3.b1.text: The seventh lot came out for the clans of the tribe of Dan:

joshua.19.p3.b2.text: Later, when the territory of the Danites was lost to them, they went up and fought against Leshem, captured it … So they took possession of Leshem, settled there, and renamed it after their father Dan.

joshua.19.p3.b3.text: … distributed by lot to the tribes of Israel at Shiloh before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. So they finished dividing up the land.

joshua.19.p3.b4.text: When they had finished distributing the land into its territories, the Israelites gave Joshua son of Nun an inheritance among them … He rebuilt the city and settled in it.
